introHtml: Beach-themed bath and body gifts bring a coastal feel to any corporate giveaway or employee appreciation package. Think branded sunscreen, aloe vera gel, and coconut-scented lotions that are practical for summer outings or beachside events. These items are especially popular for hospitality brands, resort promotions, or safety managers looking for sun-safe swag. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or pad printing for a clean, professional look that stands out by the shore.
